name: jellyfin
sdk: Repository global.json selects 9.0.x (9.0.0 with latestMinor); 9.0.311 was used locally
why: Well-known, actively maintained C# media server with 40 projects and about 2,000 C# files. It restores and builds with an installed .NET 9 SDK and has no Aspire, Node or database setup. Its layered interfaces (MediaBrowser.Controller), base-class hierarchies, same-named members on unrelated types and DI-heavy controllers exercise the navigation that CodeAtlas claims to improve. OrchardCore is larger than useful for a first baseline; eShop is smaller; nopCommerce was not needed.
